retention_analysis:

detailed_description:
A black button-tufted leather sofa stands beneath large dark-framed apartment windows. Pale residential buildings are visible outside. White sheer curtains hang beside the windows, and a neatly folded blue-and-white checked blanket rests on the sofa cushion at screen right. Soft daylight illuminates the room.

[Shot 1] One uninterrupted 15-second shot. <Subject 1> sits near the center of the sofa, knees close together, shoulders slightly drawn forward, long hair falling over her striped sweater. The camera faces her from slightly above eye level. Use restrained handheld movement with small natural sways and slight changes of tilt. Keep her face readable throughout; no cuts.

From 0 to 4 seconds, begin in a seated medium shot and slowly move closer to a head-and-shoulders view. She tightens her eyebrows, briefly closes her eyes, then opens them toward the lens and leans slightly forward. <Subject 1> (S1), speaking in a natural young adult female Mandarin voice with a slightly breathy, hurt and impatient delivery, says: <d>[Mandarin Chinese] 完啦，这回可完啦，活不了几年啦</d> Her expression asks for an answer; avoid exaggerated crying.

From 4 to 10 seconds, briefly maintain the closer view, then gradually retreat to a wider seated medium shot showing her sweater, shorts and upper thighs. Her hands remain low near her thighs. She glances aside, returns her gaze toward the camera, and continues with restrained but growing frustration: <Subject 1> (S1) says, <d>[Mandarin Chinese]今早上看新闻，专家说的，五年之内消灭平困人口</d> Let the brows, eyes and mouth respond continuously to the words rather than holding a fixed grimace.

From 10 to 15 seconds, maintain the wider composition with gentle handheld sway. <Subject 1> (S1) says with a stronger emotional emphasis: <d>[Mandarin Chinese] 哎~说我咋整啊。</d> During the first part of the sentence, she briefly lifts both hands with bent elbows in a loose, frustrated gesture, then lets them descend together onto her lap. As she finishes the question, she turns her face slightly aside and lowers her gaze. End with her hands resting low and her expression still unsettled, without a smile or an added cut.

Keep the dialogue intelligible and naturally paced within the 15-second performance. Synchronize mouth and jaw movements with every spoken word. Maintain consistent identity, hair, sweater pattern, clothing and room geometry. Show only one woman. Do not add subtitles, on-screen captions or other people.

overall_soundscape:
Only the woman's Mandarin dialogue, subtle clothing movement and a soft hand-to-lap contact when her hands settle. No narration, background ambience or walking footsteps.

non_diegetic_music:
None.
